title: Kissed Tangy Irish Collards Gratin
description: A tangy and glassy-jelly Irish dish featuring collards, yuzu-cure, and a solo-dinner serving size, perfect for a unique dinner experience. This Jain-friendly recipe is cooked in an individual-mini-cocotte vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, massage the chopped collard greens with yuzu juice, vegan butter, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper for 5 minutes.
Transfer the collard mixture to an individual-mini-cocotte vessel.
Drizzle the agave nectar over the collard mixture.
Cover the vessel with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is caramelized.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the Kissed Tangy Irish Collards Gratin hot, garnished with additional yuzu juice if desired.
